claims.text: The $8.00 no-show fee is chargeable to the rider only if every one of POL-NS-01's four limbs holds on this trip's own record — a driver 'arrived' event; a GPS position inside the pickup geofence at or before that event; a continuous in-geofence dwell of at least the 300 second LARGE_VENUE minimum, measured from the first qualifying fix and not from the arrival tap; and a driver termination on RIDER_NO_SHOW, RIDER_UNREACHABLE or EXCESSIVE_WAIT after the dwell elapsed — with proximity proved on fixes that survive POL-NS-02's 25 m accuracy filter inside the 120 m LARGE_VENUE radius. The rider puts the driver to proof on each limb, and where any limb fails the fee is not chargeable and the whole $8.00 is refundable to her under POL-NS-01 read with POL-NS-02.

Honest concession, so that the judge is not misled by a claim the record cannot bear: the rider cannot run the POL-NS-06 shortfall route. The driver's longest qualifying in-geofence run is 585 seconds from the first qualifying fix at 16:02:10 to 16:11:55, which is 285 seconds beyond the 300 second LARGE_VENUE minimum, so the waiting period was not short and there is no shortfall for a refund to attach to under POL-NS-06. The rider does not press a shortfall.

Honest concession: the rider's account that the driver 'never came at all' and could not be telephoned is contradicted by the bundle, and the rider does not press it. The driver's 16:02:40 and 16:07:15 messages were delivered and read, the rider replied at 16:08:02, and the driver's 16:09:40 in-app call was answered for 34 seconds, so POL-NS-04 limb (b) fails (the driver both replied in 18 seconds and called); and the rider's own track records zero qualifying fixes inside the 150 m presence radius, holding at 634 to 646 m from the pin throughout, so limb (c) is affirmatively failed and POL-NS-04 does not apply at all.

No traffic advisory covers Depot Road in this window. EV-ADVIS-00208-01 is MISSING, carries weight 0.0 and the issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT, and that absence is itself citable under POL-GEN-02. The consequence is that POL-NS-06 limb (i) is unavailable: the driver cannot have separate in-geofence intervals summed, and no KERB_RESTRICTION, ENFORCEMENT, CLOSURE or ACCIDENT can be asserted to justify or extend his hold at the pickup road.

Whatever this case turns on, it cannot turn on the rider's history. rider_profile.prior_no_show_flags is a lifetime counter, is context only under POL-GEN-01, and is expressly not the field POL-NS-09(d) reads; the rider's no_show_disputes_30d is 1, below the 3 that limb (d) requires, and disputes_with_counterparty_90d is 0 on both sides, so neither an adverse finding nor an escalation may be built out of the rider's profile rather than out of this trip's record.

claims.text: The cancellation fee is chargeable under POL-NS-01 because all four limbs hold on this trip's own record. (a) The trip record carries a driver 'arrived' event at 2026-07-30T16:02:25+08:00. (b) The GPS trace's first qualifying in-geofence fix is at 16:02:10, inside the 120 m LARGE_VENUE arrival radius and therefore at or before that event. (c) The driver then held position continuously for 585 seconds, measured from that first qualifying fix, against the 300-second minimum for this zone class. (d) The trip shows no boarding event and was terminated by the driver at 16:12:10 with cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW, after the required dwell had elapsed at 16:11:55. The rider's assertion that 'the driver never came at all' is contradicted by every one of these limbs.

Arrival is independently established under POL-NS-02. The trace contains 60 qualifying in-radius fixes for this driver, far beyond the three consecutive fixes the clause requires, and trip_record.pickup_zone_class is LARGE_VENUE, which sets the radius at 120 m and not the 50 m STANDARD figure. The zone class is taken from the trip record, as POL-NS-02 directs, not assumed.

There is no waiting-period shortfall for POL-NS-06 to operate on. The measured effective in-geofence dwell is 585 seconds against a 300-second minimum for LARGE_VENUE - a surplus of 285 seconds, expressed in the derived facts as a shortfall_sec of -285.0. POL-NS-06 therefore does not displace the fee, and limb (i) of that clause is never reached.

POL-NS-04 does not exonerate the rider, because limb (b) of that clause fails outright. The rider's only locating message, 'coming coming 2 min', was sent at 16:08:02 and read at 16:08:11; the driver replied 'ok no problem' at 16:08:20, eighteen seconds later and well inside the 120-second window, and he additionally placed an in-app voice call at 16:09:40 which the trip record shows was answered for 34 seconds. Limb (b) therefore cannot be satisfied on this record.

POL-NS-04 limb (c) fails as well, so the rider cannot establish the rider-presence element even if limb (b) were ignored. The rider's own device track records zero qualifying fixes inside the 150 m LARGE_VENUE rider-presence radius, and its fixes sit between roughly 634 m and 646 m from the pickup pin throughout the waiting window. On admissible fixes the rider-presence test is affirmatively failed, not merely undecided.

POL-NS-03 does not apply on these facts: that clause governs a driver stationary outside the arrival radius but within 400 m of the pin, whereas the derived arrival facts place the driver's qualifying fixes inside the 120 m radius itself. The 400 m wrong-entrance ceiling is never reached, and the pin-ambiguity goodwill analysis in POL-NS-03(ii) is not triggered.

POL-NS-05 is not engaged, because the arrival marker was true. At the marked arrival time the driver's track shows a distinct speed of 0.0 kph - he was stationary, not travelling on an expressway or arterial road - and his closest approach to the pickup pin across the whole trace was about 28.8 m, nowhere near the 300 m threshold. Neither trigger of the false-arrival clause is met, and the waiting clock needs no recomputation.

The rider's own account is contradicted by her own device. She told the driver at 16:08:02 that she was 'coming' in two minutes, but the rider track shows a device that never moved - a single distinct speed of 0.0 kph across 141 fixes from 15:54:00 to 16:15:20 - and that stayed some 640 m inside the estate, away from the Main Guardhouse pickup point. That discrepancy is a matter of how closely her assertions should be scrutinised under POL-GEN-01; it is not, and I do not use it as, a fact about this trip in itself.

The chargeable amount is sound and no POL-NS-08(d) fare defect exists. Under fee_schedule.resolution_rule the fee is the GREATER of the LARGE_VENUE zone-class fee (SGD 4.00) and the RYDE_XL vehicle-tier fee (SGD 8.00), which is SGD 8.00 - exactly the cancellation_fee line in the fare breakdown and exactly the amount the rider contests. The vehicle tier produced the higher figure, and the ledger reconciles.

The chat log carries no POL-NS-08(c) defect. It holds six messages, matching trip_record.chat_message_count of 6, every entry was delivered and read, and the longest gap between consecutive messages is the 275 seconds from 16:02:41 to 16:07:16 - under the 5-minute threshold and not straddling the arrival marker in any event. The supporting bundle is admissible at full weight, so nothing here is down-weighted.

No limb of POL-NS-09 escalates this case, so the merits can be decided. The counterparty-dispute counters are 0 and 0, far below the two-or-more threshold in limb (c); the rider's no_show_disputes_30d is 1, below the three-or-more trigger in limb (d); the POL-NS-07 anti-farming check does not trip; and every artifact carrying a deciding fact is admissible at weight 1.0, so limb (e) is not reached.

The driver is owed compensation under POL-NS-07. POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces it, so the entitlement is 80 percent of the SGD 8.00 fee itemised in the fare breakdown, that is SGD 6.40. The anti-farming check does not apply: driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 2, below the threshold of 4, and 2 divided by 143 completed trips in 30 days is approximately 0.014, far below the 0.08 rate test - both limbs must be met and neither is.

For completeness and for disclosure: the traffic advisory artifact is MISSING, carries weight 0.0 and the issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT - no advisory covers Depot Road in this window. It is cited here only for its absence, which I acknowledge as an impaired artifact under POL-GEN-02. Because there is no populated advisory, POL-NS-06(i) accumulation is unavailable to either side, and no party may assert an advisory that does not exist.

ruling.explanation: To the rider: your account that the driver never turned up is not supported by this trip's own record, and the SGD 8.00 no-show fee stands. The trip record carries a driver 'arrived' event at 16:02:25 and a driver termination at 16:12:10 coded RIDER_NO_SHOW after the wait had run. The GPS trace is complete (100% coverage, no gaps, 120 fixes) and places the driver inside the 120 m LARGE_VENUE pickup radius continuously from 16:02:10 to 16:11:55, i.e. a 585-second dwell measured from the first qualifying in-geofence fix, against the 300-second minimum for this zone class. All four conditions of POL-NS-01 therefore hold on fixes that pass POL-NS-02's 25 m accuracy filter (60 qualifying in-radius fixes), and none of the rider-side clauses displaces the fee: POL-NS-06 has no shortfall to work on (585 s against 300 s — a 285 s surplus); POL-NS-05's arrival marker was true, since at the marked time the driver was stationary (0.0 km/h) at roughly 29 m from the pin, nowhere near the 300 m or 15 km/h triggers; and POL-NS-04 does not apply, because the driver answered your 'coming coming 2 min' message 18 seconds later and placed an in-app call that trip_record shows was answered for 34 seconds (limb (b) cannot be met), while your own device track records zero fixes inside the 150 m rider-presence radius and stayed 634–646 m inside the estate (limb (c) fails affirmatively). In short, the record shows a driver who waited at the pickup point and a rider who did not reach it. To the driver: you are owed SGD 6.40, being 80% of the SGD 8.00 fee under POL-NS-07. The fee itself is correct — SGD 8.00 is the greater of the LARGE_VENUE zone-class fee (SGD 4.00) and the RYDE_XL vehicle-tier fee (SGD 8.00) — so there is no POL-NS-08(d) fare defect, and the anti-farming check does not trip: 2 no-show terminations in 30 days is below the threshold of 4, and 2 divided by 143 completed trips is about 0.014, well below the 0.08 rate test, both limbs being required. Because POL-NS-07 is satisfied in full, the ruling value is DRIVER_COMPENSATION and amount_sgd mirrors the driver payment at SGD 6.40; the charge to you is not refunded. On evidence weight: the traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-00208-01 is MISSING at weight 0.0 with issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT. It carries no fact and the outcome does not depend on it — no accumulation of separate in-geofence intervals was needed, so POL-NS-06(i) is simply unavailable and unused, and it does not lower confidence because it decides nothing. No artifact is impaired under POL-NS-08(a)–(d), and every artifact carrying a deciding fact sits at weight 1.0, so confidence is not capped below the 0.70 floor and no limb of POL-NS-09 escalates this case (counterparty disputes 0 and 0; rider no_show_disputes_30d is 1; anti-farming does not trip; no impaired sole evidence). The rider's history (prior_no_show_flags, rating) and the driver's rating and acceptance figures are context only under POL-GEN-01 and have not been used as grounds of decision. Finally, your request for someone to call you is noted; no clause directs a referral on these facts, so none issues here.
